## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`, `python scripts/generate_docs.py` and `python scripts/check_release.py`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for a change in behaviour.
- [ ] I added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` if a user can notice the change.
- [ ] I updated the documentation that the change touches, and the skill if I added a command.
- [ ] The change adds no third-party dependency and keeps the safe and private defaults.
- [ ] I used synthetic data only: no tokens, real site names, real page content or personal data.
